import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int)1e9 + 7;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static List<List<int[]>> pref = new ArrayList<>();

    static int sum(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        if (s >= MOD) s -= MOD;
        return s;
    }

    static int sub(int a, int b) {
        int s = a - b;
        if (s < 0) s += MOD;
        return s;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % MOD);
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> matrixMult(List<List<int[]>> a, List<List<int[]>> b) {
        List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            List<int[]> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                row.add(new int[]{0});
            }
            c.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int val = 0;
                for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                    val = sum(val, mult(a.get(i).get(t)[0], b.get(t).get(j)[0]));
                }
                c.get(i).set(j, new int[]{val});
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> shiftBy1(List<List<int[]>> mat) {
        List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            List<int[]> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                row.add(new int[]{0});
            }
            c.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = i;
                if (ni < k) ni = (ni + k - 1) % k;
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < k) nj = (nj + k - 1) % k;
                c.get(i).set(j, new int[]{mat.get(ni).get(nj)[0]});
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void print(List<List<int[]>> c) {
        for (List<int[]> t : c) {
            for (int[] v : t) {
                System.out.print(v[0] + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println("------------");
    }

    static void init() {
        long digs = 0;
        long cop = n;
        while (cop > 0) {
            cop /= k;
            digs++;
        }
        pref.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i <= (int)digs; i++) {
            pref.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        pref.get(0).clear();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pref.get(0).add(new int[k + 1]);
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                pref.get(0).get(i)[0] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            pref.get(0).get(i)[0] = 1;
        }
        pref.get(0).get(0)[0] = 1;
        pref.get(0).get(k)[0] = MOD - 1;
        pref.get(0).get(k)[0] = 2;

        for (int step = 0; step < digs; step++) {
            List<List<int[]>> current = pref.get(step);
            List<List<int[]>> nextPref = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                nextPref.add(new ArrayList<>());
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    nextPref.get(i).add(new int[]{current.get(i).get(j)[0]});
                }
            }
            pref.add(nextPref);
            List<List<int[]>> cur = pref.get(step);
            for (int i = 1; i <= k - 1; i++) {
                cur = shiftBy1(cur);
                pref.set(step + 1, matrixMult(pref.get(step + 1), cur));
            }
        }
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> solve(long n) {
        if (n == 0) {
            List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c.add(new ArrayList<>());
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    c.get(i).add(new int[]{0});
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c.get(i).set(i, new int[]{1});
            }
            return c;
        }
        int dig = 0;
        long pw = 1;
        while (pw <= n / k) {
            pw *= k;
            dig++;
        }
        if (n == pw) {
            return pref.get(dig);
        }
        long steps = n / pw;
        long left = n - steps * pw;
        List<List<int[]>> curMat = solve(0);
        List<List<int[]>> curCoef = pref.get(dig);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            curMat = matrixMult(curMat, curCoef);
            curCoef = shiftBy1(curCoef);
        }
        List<List<int[]>> otherMat = solve(left);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            otherMat = shiftBy1(otherMat);
        }
        return matrixMult(curMat, otherMat);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        init();
        List<List<int[]>> mat = solve(n);
        System.out.println(mat.get(k).get(k)[0]);
    }
}
